title: Coffee Shop Operations
description: Menu margins, supplies and par levels, waste log, equipment service and orders for a cafe.

spec.useCase: Marisol Brennan-Okoye owns a coffee shop and uses this to see menu margins, what is below par, what is being wasted, which machines are due for service and what is on order.
